summary: 珍珠的身价取决于形成方式、品质和稀有程度。文章区分天然、养殖与仿制珍珠，接着从形成、鉴别讲到波斯湾等传统产区以及现代市场。
logic: 区分形成方式与仿制品
用光泽、形态等判断价值
传统采珠地和现代贸易

paragraphs.brief: 许多埃及领导人都珍惜珍珠，常常与珍藏的珍珠一起被埋葬。
sentences: Long known as the “Queen of Gems”, pearls possess a history and allure far beyond what today’s wearer may recognize.
珍珠古老地称为 " 宝石女王 "，其历史和诱惑力远远超过今天戴珍珠的人所能认识的程度。
Throughout much of recorded history, a natural pearl necklace comprised of matched spheres was a treasure of almost incomparable value, in fact, the most expensive jewelry in the world.
在记录的大部分历史中，由相匹配的球体组成的天然珍珠项链是价值几乎无法比拟的宝藏，事实上，是世界上最昂贵的珠宝。
Before the creation of cultured pearls in the early 1900s, natural pearls were so rare and expensive that they were reserved almost exclusively for the noble and very rich.
在19世纪初创造养殖珍珠之前，天然珍珠非常稀有和昂贵，几乎只留给高贵和非常富有的人。
The ancient Egyptians were particularly fond of their pearls.
古埃及人特别喜欢他们的珍珠
Many Egyptian leaders treasured pearls so much that they were often buried along with their cherished pearl collection.
许多埃及领导人都珍惜珍珠，常常与珍藏的珍珠一起被埋葬。
In the Orient and Persian Empire, pearls were ground into costly powders to cure anything from heart disease to epilepsy, with possible aphrodisiac uses as well.
在东方帝国和波斯帝国，珍珠被埋在昂贵的粉末中，可以治愈心脏病和癫痫，并可能使用春药。
China’s long recorded history also provides ample evidence of the importance of pearls.
中国历史悠久，也充分证明了珍珠的重要性。

paragraphs.brief: 珍珠通常分为三类：天然珍珠、养殖珍珠和模拟珍珠。
sentences: Pearls usually fall into three categories—natural pearls, cultured pearls and simulated pearls.
珍珠通常分为三类：天然珍珠、养殖珍珠和模拟珍珠。
A natural pearl forms when an irritant, such as a piece of sand, works its way into a particular species of oyster, mussel, or clam.
天然珍珠形成时刺激剂，如沙子进入了牡蛎、贝类或蛤类的物种
As a defense mechanism, the mollusk secretes a fluid to coat the irritant.
作为防御机制软体动物会分泌液体来涂上刺激剂
Layer upon layer of this coating is deposited on the irritant until a lustrous pearl is formed.
这种涂层的层层沉在刺激剂上，直到一颗光滑的珍珠形成
A cultured pearl undergoes the same process.
养珍珠也会经历同样的过程
The only difference between natural pearls and cultured pearls is that the irritant is a surgically implanted bead or piece of shell called Mother of Pearl.
天然珍珠和养殖珍珠的唯一区别是刺激物是外科植入的珠子或一块外壳叫做珍珠之母
Often, these shells are ground oyster shells that are worth significant amounts of money in their own right as irritant-catalysts for quality pearls.
通常，这些炮弹是牡蛎的地面壳，本身作为优质珍珠的刺激剂，价值巨大。
The resulting core is much larger than in a natural pearl.
所产生的核比天然珍珠要大得多。
Imitation pearls are a different story altogether.
仿造珍珠是一个完全不同的故事
In most cases, a glass bead is dipped into a solution made from fish scales.
在多数情况下，玻璃珠被浸入用鱼量制成的溶液中。
This coating is thin and may eventually wear off.
这种涂层薄，最终可能会磨损。
One can usually tell an imitation by biting on it.
人们通常会咬到它就能看出来模仿
The island of Mallorca in Spain is known for its imitation pearl industry.
西班牙的马洛卡岛以模仿珍珠工业闻名。

paragraphs.brief: 无论使用何种方法获取珍珠，这一过程通常需要几年时间。
sentences: Regardless of the method used to acquire a pearl, the process usually takes several years.
无论使用何种方法获取珍珠，这一过程通常需要几年时间。
Mussels must reach a mature age, which can take up to 3 years, and then be implanted or naturally receive an irritant.
藻类必须达到成熟年龄，可长达3年，然后被植入或自然地受到刺激。
Once the irritant is in place, it can take up to another 3 years for the pearl to reach its full size.
一旦刺激剂到位珍珠的体积可以再用三年才能达到全尺寸
Often, the irritant may be rejected, the pearl will be terrifically misshapen, or the oyster may simply die from disease or countless other complications.
刺激剂往往会被拒绝，珍珠会非常难吃，或者牡蛎可能只是死于疾病或无数其他并发症。
By the end of a 5 to 10 year cycle, only 50% of the oysters will have survived.
到5至10年周期结束时，只有50%的牡蛎存活下来。
And of the pearls produced, only approximately 5% are of a quality substantial enough for top jewelry makers.
在生产的珍珠中，只有大约5%的珍珠质量足以供顶级珠宝制造商使用。

paragraphs.brief: 另一方面，尺寸与牡蛎的年代有关，牡蛎创造了珍珠(较成熟的牡蛎生产较大的珍珠)，以及珍珠生长的地点。
sentences: How can untrained eyes determine a pearl’s worth?
珍珠的价值如何由未经训练的眼睛决定？
Luster and size are generally considered the two main factors to look for.
一般认为拉斯特和大小是需要寻找的两个主要因素。
Luster, for instance, depends on the fineness and evenness of the layers.
例如，光滑取决于这些层的优雅和平衡。
The deeper the glow, the more perfect the shape and surface, the more valuable they are.
光线越深形状和表面越完美价值就越大
Size, on the other hand, has to do with the age of the oyster that created the pearl (the more mature oysters produce larger pearls) and the location in which the pearl was cultured.
另一方面，尺寸与牡蛎的年代有关，牡蛎创造了珍珠(较成熟的牡蛎生产较大的珍珠)，以及珍珠生长的地点。
The South Sea waters of Australia tend to produce the larger pearls; probably because the water along the coastline is supplied with rich nutrients from the ocean floor.
澳大利亚的南海水域往往产出较大的珍珠；可能是因为海岸线上的水域有海底丰富的养分。
Also, the type of mussel being common to the area seems to possess a predilection for producing comparatively large pearls.
此外，该地区常见的贝类似乎具有生产相对较大珍珠的倾向。

paragraphs.brief: 一般来说，养殖珍珠的价值比天然珍珠低，而模仿珍珠几乎没有价值。
sentences: In general, cultured pearls are less valuable than natural pearls, whereas imitation pearls have almost no value.
一般来说，养殖珍珠的价值比天然珍珠低，而模仿珍珠几乎没有价值。
One way that jewelers can determine whether a pearl is cultured or natural is to have a gem lab perform an X-ray of the pearl.
珠宝商可以确定珍珠是培养的还是天然的一种方式是让宝石实验室对珍珠进行X光检查
If the X-ray reveals a nucleus, the pearl is likely a bead nucleated saltwater pearl.
如果X光显示一个核，珍珠可能是珠子核盐水珍珠。

If no nucleus is present, but irregular and small dark inner spots indicating a cavity are visible, combined with concentric rings of organic substance, the pearl is likely a cultured freshwater pearl.
如果没有核，但有不规则的、暗暗的小内部点显示有洞，加上有机物质的同心环，珍珠很可能是培养出来的淡水珍珠。
Among cultured pearls, Akoya pearls from Japan are some of the most lustrous.
在养殖的珍珠中，来自日本的赤田珍珠是最美的。
Although imitation pearls look the part, they do not have the same weight or smoothness as real pearls, and their luster will also dim greatly.
虽然仿造珍珠看起来像那部分，它们并没有像真的珍珠一样的重量或光滑，它们的光滑也将大大地淡化。

paragraphs.brief: 具有讽刺意味的是，印度的天然珍珠大部分来源于巴林。
sentences: Historically, the world’s best pearls came from the Persian Gulf, especially around what is now Bahrain.
历史上，世界上最好的珍珠来自波斯湾，特别是现在的巴林。
The pearls of the Persian Gulf were naturally created and collected by breath-hold divers.
波斯湾的珍珠自然由呼吸的潜水者创造和收集
Unfortunately, the natural pearl industry of the Persian Gulf ended abruptly in the early 1930s with the discovery of large deposits of oil.
不幸的是，波斯湾天然珍珠工业在1930年代初突然结束，发现了大量的石油储藏。
The water pollution resulting from spilled oil and indiscriminate overfishing of oysters essentially ruined the pristine waters of the Gulf that once produced pearls.
溢出石油和滥用牡蛎造成的水污染，从根本上破坏了曾经产产珍珠的海湾原始水域。
Still, Bahrain remains one of the foremost trading centers for high quality pearls.
然而，巴林仍然是优质珍珠的首要贸易中心之一。
In fact, cultured pearls are banned from the Bahrain pearl market, in an effort to preserve the location’s heritage.
事实上，为了保存该地点的遗产，巴林珍珠市场禁止种植珍珠。
Nowadays, the largest stock of natural pearls probably resides in India.
目前，印度可能拥有最大的天然珍珠。
Ironically, much of India’s stock of natural pearls came originally from Bahrain.
具有讽刺意味的是，印度的天然珍珠大部分来源于巴林。
Unlike Bahrain, which has essentially lost its pearl resource, traditional pearl fishing is still practiced on a small scale in India.
与巴林不同的是，它基本上失去了珍珠资源，传统的珍珠捕捞在印度仍然在小规模上进行。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，日本控制了大约80%的世界珍珠市场，澳大利亚和中国分别是第二和第三家。
sentences: Pearls also come in many colours.
珍珠也以多种颜色出现
The most popular colours are white, cream, and pink.
最受欢迎的颜色是白色、奶油和粉红色。
Silver, black, and gold are also gaining interest.
银、黑、金也越来越受欢迎
In fact, a deep lustrous black pearl is one of the rarest finds in the pearling industry, usually only being found in the South Sea near Australia.
事实上，在珍珠工业中一只深厚的黑珍珠是最稀有的发现之一通常只在澳大利亚附近的南海找到
Thus, they can be one of the more costly items.
因此，它们可以成为费用更高的项目之一。
Nowadays, pearls predominantly come from Japan, Australia, Indonesia, Myanmar, China, India, the Philippines, and Tahiti.
如今，珍珠主要来自日本、澳大利亚、印度尼西亚、缅甸、中国、印度、菲律宾和塔希提岛。
Japan, however, controls roughly 80% of the world pearl market, with Australia and China coming in second and third, respectively.
然而，日本控制了大约80%的世界珍珠市场，澳大利亚和中国分别是第二和第三家。

items.why: “irritant may be rejected (排斥) / misshapen (变形) / die (死亡)” 直接说明培育过程中的困难与失败率。

items.en: causes affecting the size of natural pearls
items.zh: 影响自然珍珠大小的原因
items.why: 明确给出影响珍珠大小的多种原因: 母贝年龄、产地位置、营养与贝种。

items.zh: 珍珠周围的古老的习俗
items.why: 讲述古代与珍珠相关的风俗与用途 (随荆、入药、春药)。

items.en: distinctions between cultured pearls and natural ones
items.zh: 养殖珍珠和天然珍珠之间的区别
items.why: 直接对比“天然珠" 与“养殖珠” 的差别 (是否人工植入核)。

items.en: Throughout history, people in ________ used pearls for medicine and philtres.
items.zh: 历史上，________的人们曾用珍珠入药，也用它调制爱情魔药。
items.why: “medicine and philtres (药与春药)” 对应波斯/东方的用法。

items.en: And ________ owns the reputation for its imitation pearl industry.
items.why: 直接点名马略卡以仿珍珠产业闻名。

items.en: The country ________ usually produces the larger pearls due to the favourable environment along the coastline, while the nation of ____ (Q8) manufactures some of the most glistening cultured pearls.
items.zh: ________沿海的环境适宜，出产的珍珠往往较大。________（Q8）出产的养殖珍珠中，有些光泽格外耀眼。
items.why: 说明澳大利亚因海域条件而出大珠。

items.en: The country ____ (Q7) usually produces the larger pearls due to the favourable environment along the coastline, while the nation of ________ manufactures some of the most glistening cultured pearls.
items.zh: ________（Q7）沿海的环境适宜，出产的珍珠往往较大。________出产的养殖珍珠中，有些光泽格外耀眼。
items.why: 日本Akoya 以光泽度高著称。

items.en: In the past, the country ________ in the Persian Gulf produced the world’s best pearls.
items.zh: 过去，世界上最好的珍珠产自波斯湾国家________。
items.why: 历史上最好的珍珠产自波斯湾，尤以巴林附近。

items.en: At present, the major remaining suppliers of natural pearls are in ________.
items.zh: 如今，仍在供应天然珍珠的主要产地位于________。
items.why: 现今天然珍珠主要存量在印度。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

items.en: A cultured pearl’s centre is often significantly larger than that in a natural pearl.
items.zh: 养珍珠中心往往比天然珍珠中心大得多。
items.why: 养殖珠因植入珠核 (bead/shell),其“中心/核心" 更大，与题干一致。

items.en: Imitation pearls are usually the same price as natural ones.
items.zh: 仿造珍珠通常与天然珍珠相同价格。
items.why: 题干称仿珠与天然珠同价，文中明确仿珠“几乎没有价值”,与之矛盾。

items.en: Akoya pearls from Japan glow more deeply than South Sea pearls from Australia.
items.zh: 日本的秋叶珍珠比澳大利亚的南海珍珠更亮。
items.why: 文中只说日本 Akoya 很有光泽，澳洲南洋珠个头大，未直接比较二者“glow more deeply/光泽更深” 的强弱关系，因此未给出。

points: “irritant may be rejected (排斥) / misshapen (变形) / die (死亡)” 直接说明培育过程中的困难与失败率。
题干称仿珠与天然珠同价，文中明确仿珠“几乎没有价值”,与之矛盾。
clauses: Before the creation of cultured pearls in the early 1900s, natural pearls were so rare and expensive ….
“that they were reserved almost exclusively for the noble and very rich”补足 rare 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 rare 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
Layer upon layer of this coating is deposited on the irritant ….
连接词 until 引出“until a lustrous pearl is formed”，说明主句的时间关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 until 把这一层关系补进去。
